LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchMasterFishing.label: Advanced fishing
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchMasterFishing.descriptio: The fishers of the binguin have turned angling into a discipline of engineering: the rod assembly table, interchangeable shafts and tips, straight and curved hooks, and baits blended from foodstuffs - every rod is a work of art, made to measure... but why is it used for hitting people?
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchUltimateFishing.label: Ultimate fishing
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchUltimateFishing.descript: The fishers of the binguin have at last reached the end of the way of angling: they found that by gathering the form and the spirit of every fish of the frozen plains into a single blade, they can call forth the "Zenith Fish Slash" - the phantom shapes of fourteen fish strike down from the zenith, one after another. Legend says that only one who has made the rod and the body into one is worthy to wield this blade.
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchAdvancedFishing.label: advanced fishing
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchAdvancedFishing.descript: For generations the fishers of the binguin have kept company with cold waters, and now they rise a step higher: they have learned to weave crab traps, to blend baits, and to forge iron and uranium into mass-produced fishing rods. From this day on, every stretch of water on the cold plain is a granary to them. (Odyssey DLC only)
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchTianwen.label: Questions to Heaven
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchTianwen.description: The questions of generation upon generation of binguin stargazing have at last gathered into one: "Where is the starry sky?" Binguin observers have deciphered the coordinates of an ancient beacon set among the stars, and learned to hurl vast signals into deep space. With this the colonists will question the heavens: the binguin mothership waits among the stars for an answer.
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchIcyPeaks.label: Heaping Ice, Heaping Geese
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchIcyPeaks.description: They have mastered the craft of turning the resources of the frozen plains into the stuff of daily use: stone mined and cut by machine, dried fish, cheese sticks and fish canned until it stinks, and blue-and-black furniture of ice and snow.
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchEnvironment.label: Environmental Protection
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchEnvironment.description: For reasons of their own, they have worked out an advanced pollution pump whose efficiency far exceeds the original.
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchRecycling.label: Waste Recycling
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchRecycling.description: Now the binguin count pollution a renewable resource. They have built an all-new recycler, which breaks toxic waste down into usable minerals.
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchRecyclingProMax.label: Efficient Waste Recycling
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchRecyclingProMax.descript: Binguin engineers have bettered the recycler's breakdown process - from the same toxic waste they now press half again as much usable mineral.
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchAtmosphere.label: Atmosphere Control
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchAtmosphere.description: Binguin observers are deeply versed in the ways of the sky. They have built the atmosphere controller, driving the heavens with cold energy - clear or rain, wind or snow, all in the palm of the hand.
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchMachining.label: Binguin Machining
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchMachining.description: Binguin artisans forge steel into fine mechanisms, and build the cold-proof machining table - running as ever in the biting cold.
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchClothing.label: Binguin Clothing
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchClothing.description: The tailoring craft of the binguin, weaving garments from blue-black down and cold-ice fiber. Joined to machining, it can also produce the ice rock flak vest.
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchCosplay.label: Binguin Cosplay Outfits
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchCosplay.description: A small hobby kept between their observations: the binguin girls stitch down and cloth into all sorts of "costumes out of legend", and once dressed, they feel themselves become characters in a story.
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchStargazing.label: Stargazing
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchStargazing.description: Binguin observers gaze all night at the assembled stars, and at last have learned to read the language of meteors. They have built the meteor guide, drawing down things from beyond the sky by gravity, and turning meteorites into the bounty of the frozen plains.
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchFrostAssault.label: Frost Assault Weapons
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchFrostAssault.description: Binguin artisans gather clusters of deep cold into the warhead: when an iceburst round strikes it gathers cold energy within the foe, and when the ice burst fills, the part struck cracks and shatters in an instant.
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchEndlessSnow.label: Endless Snow
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchEndlessSnow.description: Amid snow without end, a form like lightning - once this art is loosed, it is the ultimate.
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchIceArmor.label: Binguin Armor
LanguageData.Binguin_ResearchIceArmor.description: Binguin artisans weave plasteel into armor: light as a feather, harder than cold iron, so that not even vacuum and killing cold can bar the ranging of a scout.
